data.notes: November 2026’s confirmed Miami calendar is strongest on electronic nightlife, arena-scale pop/dance, and Latin-Caribbean/Brazilian club culture.

events.title: John Summit: CTRL Escape Tour
events.summary: John Summit brings his CTRL Escape Tour to Kaseya Center for two nights. The arena lists performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21, 2026.

events.title: Martin Garrix at LIV Nightclub
events.summary: Martin Garrix headlines LIV Nightclub Miami on Saturday, November 7, 2026. The venue lists doors at 11:30 PM and a 21+ entry requirement.

events.title: Dennis Cruz + Moodymann b2b Carl Craig
events.summary: Club Space hosts Dennis Cruz plus a Detroit-heavy Moodymann b2b Carl Craig set on the Terrace. The venue lists the party for Friday, November 6, 2026, running into Saturday morning.

events.title: Halloweek: Dixon B2B Jimi Jules & WhoMadeWho (Hybrid Set)
events.summary: Club Space’s Halloweek run closes on the Terrace with Dixon B2B Jimi Jules and a hybrid set from WhoMadeWho. The official venue page lists Sunday, November 1, 2026, with doors at 11:00 PM.

events.title: Doja Cat: Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Ma Vie World Tour to Kaseya Center with special guest Latto. The arena lists the show for Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 7:30 PM.

events.title: Carl Cox + Carlita
events.summary: Carl Cox and Carlita headline a Club Space night spanning techno, house and eclectic club sounds, with Miami residents Ms. Mada and Sister System rounding out the bill.

events.title: UNREAL
events.summary: Germany’s UNREAL techno brand takes over Factory Town’s Infinity Room for a high-intensity night billed as its biggest North American show yet, with lineup TBA on the RA listing.

events.title: Oscar G + Anastazja
events.summary: Nervous Records presents Miami house figure Oscar G with Anastazja at ZeyZey. The listing notes Oscar G’s Murk legacy and long-running status as a Club Space resident.

events.title: The Neighbourhood: The Wourld Tour
events.summary: The Neighbourhood plays Kaseya Center on The Wourld Tour with special guest Nessa Barrett. The official arena page lists Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Tudo Bem
events.summary: People Places Things Miami and Rhythm Foundation bring Tudo Bem to Miami Beach Bandshell for a Thanksgiving Eve edition featuring KARAN!, DJ Craze, Lamebot, and resident Jean Sean. The listing highlights Brazilian funk and bass-heavy club sounds.

events.title: STAMPED Pool Party: AYA & Friends
events.summary: AYA’s recurring STAMPED series brings Afrobeats, amapiano and sounds from across the African continent to a rooftop pool-party format at Arlo Wynwood.

events.title: Vicente García
events.summary: Dominican singer-songwriter Vicente García plays ZeyZey’s Zaku Stage. The venue notes his Caribbean-rooted sound and Latin Grammy-winning catalog.

events.title: Reggaeton Rave
events.summary: Reggaeton Rave takes over ZeyZey’s Zaku Stage on Friday, November 27, 2026. The promoter describes the event as a collision of Latinx and electronic music in a dance-focused format.

events.title: Resistance Opening Party - Miss Monique
events.summary: RESISTANCE Miami opens Season 4 at M2 with Miss Monique, Fur Coat, Nico Moon B2B Polk and Bassett in a techno/tech-house club setting.

events.title: Helado Negro and Reyna Tropical as “Helado Tropical”
events.summary: Helado Negro and Reyna Tropical perform together as Helado Tropical at ZeyZey’s Zaku Stage. ZeyZey frames the project as ambient, rhythmic, intimate, and expansive Latin-rooted music.

events.title: Jamrock Cruise 2026 Official Post Party
events.summary: The 11th annual Jamrock Cruise official post-party brings leading reggae and dancehall DJs to Blackbird Ordinary for a free 21+ diaspora-club event tied to the cruise community.

events.title: Christian Löffler LIVE – Fall 2026 Tour
events.summary: Christian Löffler brings his live Fall 2026 Tour to ZeyZey’s Zaku Stage. ZeyZey describes the German producer’s sound as atmospheric electronic music blending ambient, techno, house, and acoustic elements.

events.title: Beirut Nights In
events.summary: Beirut Nights In comes to ZeyZey with BNI DJs Anthony Raad and Mark Azar. The night is built around Middle Eastern nightlife, Arab diaspora culture, and house-rooted global electronic sounds.

events.title: RUSH: Fifty Something
events.summary: RUSH brings its Fifty Something tour to Hard Rock Live in nearby Hollywood for two confirmed performances on November 5 and November 7, 2026. The tour celebrates the band’s legacy with Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson honoring Neil Peart.

events.title: Zayn — The Konnakol Tour
events.summary: Zayn brings The Konnakol Tour to Kaseya Center on November 20, 2026. The venue confirms the Friday arena show with an 8:00 PM start time.

events.title: Jack White Live 2026
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Jack White is confirmed for two nights at The Fillmore Miami Beach on November 17 and 18, 2026. The listing frames the shows as part of his expanded 2026 tour.

events.title: URGE Miami Thanksgiving Festival 2026
events.summary: Miami’s major Thanksgiving-weekend LGBTQ circuit festival returns with multi-day dance programming across Miami/Miami Beach, including daytime events, nighttime experiences, a Beach Party and Monday morning afterhours.

events.title: Aitana — Cuarto Azul World Tour
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Spanish pop artist Aitana brings her Cuarto Azul World Tour to The Fillmore Miami Beach on November 29, 2026. Live Nation confirms the Sunday 8:00 PM performance at the Miami Beach venue.

events.title: Il Volo Live in Concert
events.summary: Classical crossover pop trio Il Volo performs at Hard Rock Live in Hollywood on November 10, 2026. The venue listing confirms the 8:00 PM concert and describes the group’s international pop-classical reach.

events.title: El Cuarteto de Nos
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at The Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Uruguayan Latin alternative band El Cuarteto de Nos performs at The Fillmore Miami Beach on November 14, 2026. The listing confirms an 8:00 PM start at the Miami Beach theater.

events.title: UB40 — The Unstoppable Tour 2026
events.summary: UB40 closes its North American The Unstoppable Tour with a confirmed Hard Rock Live performance in Hollywood on November 15, 2026. The venue announcement lists the Sunday show at 7:00 PM.

events.title: O.A.R. — Three Decades Tour
events.summary: O.A.R. performs at Hard Rock Live in Hollywood on November 13, 2026, as part of the band’s Three Decades Tour. The venue confirms the Friday 6:30 PM show.

events.title: Buena Vista Orchestra
events.summary: LPR presents Buena Vista Orchestra at Miami Beach Bandshell on November 21, 2026. The event page confirms an all-ages 8:00 PM show with doors at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Duelo
events.summary: Grupo Duelo performs at Miami Beach Bandshell on November 28, 2026. The venue calendar confirms the 8:00 PM Saturday show by the romantic norteño band.
